clauses.quote: the Supervisor shall first seek to reach the Teacher and obtain the consent to unlock the property.
the Supervisor may open the lock.
Teachers shall have access to a lounge, exclusively for their use, in each School.
The SCAC shall develop policies and procedures for the use of the lounge.
Where possible, DCPS shall provide free parking to Teachers at each School.
Teachers shall have priority in parking unless a preexisting Agreement provides otherwise.
The Parties agree to explore means of providing free parking for Teachers when such parking is insufficient at a School.
clauses.notes: Joint commitment to explore; lacks modal verb.

clauses.quote: Money earned through school projects shall be kept in the Student Activity Fund (SAF) maintained at each school.
The Supervisor has the ultimate responsibility for all SAF monies received or disbursed within the school.
Projects shall be reviewed and approved by the Supervisor before being started.
Any funds raised under the conditions described in this Article shall be deposited in the SAF and shall be used for school purposes only.
clauses.subject_text: Any funds raised under the conditions described in this Article

clauses.quote: Funds raised by individual teachers or groups of teachers for specific uses (e.g., classroom grade level, departmental or recognized school club needs), shall be administered through the SAF as a separate “Activity” and used for the purpose for which the funds were raised
clauses.subject_text: Funds raised by individual teachers or groups of teachers for specific uses (e.g., classroom grade level, departmental or recognized school club needs)

clauses.quote: those persons involved in the fund raising may agree to use all or part of the funds for other school purposes
